# `scripts/post-process/utilities.py`

Source: [utilities.py](../../../../scripts/post-process/utilities.py)

Shared helpers of the post-processing scripts: `Paths` (code, scratch, simulation and halo
directories; `SAHYADRI_SCRATCH` overrides the defaults), `Constants` (physical constants) and
`Utilities` (logging, timing, selection helpers).

- [`class Paths`](#class-paths) - Paths for various local directories.

### Utilities.heaviside

```python
heaviside(self, x)
```

Heaviside step function, 1/2 at 0.

### Utilities.wpercentile

```python
wpercentile(self, data, weights=None, percentile=50.0)
```

Weighted percentiles of data set (flattened by default).
If weights is None, calculates usual percentile using numpy.percentile().
If weights is not None, should be of same shape as data containing weights (needn't be normalised).
Default percentile is 50 (median), controlled by percentile kwarg.
Returns (weighted) percentile of data, without interpolation.

### Utilities.gen_latin_hypercube

```python
gen_latin_hypercube(self, Nsamp=10, dim=2, symmetric=True, param_mins=None, param_maxs=None, rng=None)
```

```text
Generate Latin hypercube sample (symmetric by default). 
 Either param_mins and param_maxs should both be None or both be array-like of shape (dim,). 
-- rng: either None or instance of numpy.random.RandomState(). Default None.
 Code from FirefoxMetzger's answer at
 https://codereview.stackexchange.com/questions/223569/generating-latin-hypercube-samples-with-numpy
 See https://citeseerx.ist.psu.edu/viewdoc/download?doi=10.1.1.49.7292&rep=rep1&type=pdf
 for some ideas reg utility of symmetric Latin hypercubes.
 Returns array of shape (Nsamp,dim) with values in range (0,1) or respective minimum to maximum values.
```

### Utilities.time_this

```python
time_this(self, start_time, logfile=None)
```

Print (or log) the time since `start_time` as minutes and seconds.

### Utilities.derivative

```python
derivative(self, f_pp, f_p, f0, f_m, f_mm, h, order=1)
```

Return 5-point estimate of 1st or 2nd order derivatives. Error in each case is O(h^4).

### Utilities.select_these_scalar

```python
select_these_scalar(self, elmt, wanted_elmt)
```

Select elements from elmt which belong to wanted\_elmt.
For fast evaluation with large arrays, ensure wanted\_elmt is
a set by applying set() to the array.
Returns boolean array of shape elmt.

### Utilities.select_not_these_scalar

```python
select_not_these_scalar(self, elmt, wanted_elmt)
```

Select elements from elmt which \*do not\* belong to wanted\_elmt.
For fast evaluation with large arrays, ensure wanted\_elmt is
a set by applying set() to the array.
Returns boolean array of shape elmt.
